data.name: Sharwikash
data.gender_notes: Sharwikash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shri is the Hindu Goddess of Wealth and Fortune. Wiki is the Sanskrit word for God. Kaash means prosperity. So, Sharwikash means 'God of Wealth and Prosperity'. The name Sharwikash carries the meaning “God of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwikash usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and spiritual wealth.
data.etymology: Sharwikash belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwikash total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
